## Pearl of the Day

```{ojs}
pearlsData = {
  const { initializeApp, getApps, getApp } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-app.js");
  const { getFirestore, collection, onSnapshot } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-firestore.js");

  const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: "AIzaSyD1FLnIrd86qOsFPLi5y1q_EIU0lhL5gxc",
    authDomain: "evdtoolkit.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "evdtoolkit",
    storageBucket: "evdtoolkit.firebasestorage.app",
    messagingSenderId: "1002374431151",
    appId: "1:1002374431151:web:fe3724bb1f39eb4744af5a"
  };

  const app = getApps().length ? getApp() : initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  const db = getFirestore(app);

  return Generators.observe(notify => {
    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(collection(db, "ClinicalPearls"), snapshot => {
      notify(snapshot.docs.map(d => d.data()));
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
// Port of ContentView.swift's todaysPearl: same pearl for everyone on a
// given calendar day, rotating through the live Firestore-backed list.
todaysPearl = {
  if (pearlsData.length === 0) return null;
  const start = new Date(new Date().getFullYear(), 0, 0);
  const diff = new Date() - start;
  const dayOfYear = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  return pearlsData[dayOfYear % pearlsData.length];
}
```

```{ojs}
todaysPearl
  ? html`<div style="background-color:#eef6ff;border-left:5px solid #2c7be5;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;">
      <div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.04em;color:#2c7be5;">💡 ${todaysPearl.category ?? "Pearl"}</div>
      <div style="margin-top:6px;font-size:15px;">${todaysPearl.pearl ?? ""}</div>
    </div>`
  : html`<div class="fs-empty">Loading today's pearl…</div>`
```

## About This Project

EVD practices vary widely across institutions, particularly in device setup, leveling, and management. This variability can lead to confusion, communication gaps, and potential safety risks.

The goal of this toolkit is to provide a standardized, visual, and practical approach to EVD education while recognizing real-world variability in systems and workflows.
